systemd_requirements.principal: separately admitted publisher UID, never agentdev
systemd_requirements.credential_custody: separate signer/custody principal; no same-unit key copy
systemd_requirements.filesystem: immutable reviewed code; no worker checkout access; private anchored journal
systemd_requirements.process: verified proc/ptrace/process_vm/FD/env/dump denial in both directions
systemd_requirements.resources: one bounded operation; tasks, memory, CPU, output and wall deadlines
systemd_requirements.network: separate fixed-origin egress transport; no generic proxy or worker access
systemd_requirements.activation: no listener/service/auto-start implementation; separate human approval

apparmor_requirements.attachment: effective enforced publisher and custody profiles, verified after exec and reboot
apparmor_requirements.positive_controls: independent fixed peer, allowed artifact bytes and exact operation
apparmor_requirements.negative_controls: separately approved disposable tests, not this offline model
